d: Short, ash-grey hair with a side-swept fringe and a long single strand falling over the left shoulder. Sharp, narrow crimson eyes with a neutral, stoic expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a black suit jacket with red piping over a black shirt and a red cravat secured by a gold cross ornament. A single gold monocle over the left eye and a white glove on the left hand.
